title: Nano Banana 2 Lite
summary: Generate image with Nano Banana 2 Lite
description: Google Nano Banana 2 Lite — budget Nano Banana 2: fast text-to-image and image editing with multi-reference composition from up to 14 reference images. Fixed 1K output at a flat 40 credits per image.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 14) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image.
